quality_kpis.label: Migration Readiness Score
quality_kpis.formula: weighted source coverage, test readiness, and complexity density
quality_kpis.decision_value: Identifies apps ready for migration wave planning.

quality_kpis.label: Modernization Candidate Rate
quality_kpis.formula: apps with dependency or complexity evidence / total apps * 100
quality_kpis.decision_value: Quantifies the portfolio modernization backlog.

quality_kpis.label: Technical Debt Index
quality_kpis.formula: average complexity, dependency count, and security signals
quality_kpis.decision_value: Prioritizes refactor, replatform, or deeper technical assessment before cutover.

quality_kpis.label: Dependency Coupling Index
quality_kpis.formula: dependency analyzer dependency count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Identifies co-migration groups and sequencing constraints.

quality_kpis.label: Blast Radius Score
quality_kpis.formula: dependency + endpoint + data-access evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Helps decide wave placement, co-living need, and rollback rigor.

quality_kpis.label: Security Exposure
quality_kpis.formula: security token evidence count across analyzer payloads
quality_kpis.decision_value: Blocks unsafe releases and prioritizes security remediation.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import SAST/SCA/SBOM results for vulnerability-grade precision.

quality_kpis.label: Source Evidence Coverage
quality_kpis.formula: apps with source inventory / total apps * 100
quality_kpis.decision_value: Flags partial uploads and hidden unknowns.

quality_kpis.label: Test Readiness
quality_kpis.formula: apps with detected test/spec files / total apps * 100
quality_kpis.decision_value: Shows whether migrated behavior can be validated.

quality_kpis.label: Data Migration Complexity
quality_kpis.formula: data-access analyzer evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Selects rehost, replatform, refactor, or coexistence approach.

quality_kpis.label: Observability Readiness
quality_kpis.formula: health, observability, monitoring, and logging evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Determines whether the migrated app can be operated in production.

quality_kpis.label: Target-Stack Fit
quality_kpis.formula: source coverage, observability, and test readiness weighted score
quality_kpis.decision_value: Prevents false readiness when target assumptions do not match evidence.

quality_kpis.label: Business Criticality
quality_kpis.formula: static impact score from dependency, endpoint, data, and security surface
quality_kpis.decision_value: Combines business value with technical risk to choose sequence.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import owner, SLA, active-user, revenue, and priority metadata for business-grade criticality.

quality_kpis.label: Cost/TCO Delta
quality_kpis.formula: cost, TCO, sizing, license, BoM evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Supports fund/defer/retire decisions.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import current run cost, target run cost, license cost, migration estimate, and transition cost inputs.

quality_kpis.label: DORA Delivery Baseline
quality_kpis.formula: deployment, release, incident, pipeline, and DORA evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Separates migration success from code movement alone.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import deployment and incident telemetry per app/service.

quality_kpis.label: Technical Debt Ratio
quality_kpis.formula: technical debt index normalized as remediation-ratio input
quality_kpis.decision_value: Replaces ad hoc maintainability assessment with a migration debt ratio.

quality_kpis.label: Complexity Hotspot Density
quality_kpis.formula: high-complexity analyzer entries / complexity entries * 100
quality_kpis.decision_value: Drives refactor-first and test-first planning.

quality_kpis.label: Test Coverage
quality_kpis.formula: detected test/spec files / source inventory files * 100
quality_kpis.decision_value: Low coverage raises migration equivalence risk.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import coverage reports for executable line/branch coverage.

quality_kpis.label: Functional Equivalence Risk
quality_kpis.formula: inverse test readiness plus bounded dependency pressure
quality_kpis.decision_value: Determines need for characterization tests and parallel run.

quality_kpis.label: Data Gravity Score
quality_kpis.formula: bounded data-access analyzer evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Chooses big-bang, phased, or co-living migration.

quality_kpis.label: Runtime Golden Signals Baseline
quality_kpis.formula: health and observability evidence signal count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Defines objective post-migration acceptance.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import traffic, latency, errors, and saturation telemetry.

quality_kpis.label: License and Compliance Risk
quality_kpis.formula: license, SBOM, and compliance evidence count
quality_kpis.decision_value: Prevents migration packages that cannot be deployed.
quality_kpis.capture_requirement: Import SBOM and license policy scan results.

quality_kpis.label: Strangler Feasibility
quality_kpis.formula: readiness minus coupling penalty plus endpoint seam credit
quality_kpis.decision_value: Chooses strangler-style modernization versus replatform/rewrite.

quality_kpis.label: Automation Potential
quality_kpis.formula: source coverage, test readiness, and target-stack fit weighted score
quality_kpis.decision_value: Identifies apps suitable for migration factory automation.

quality_kpis.label: Unknown Dependency Count
quality_kpis.formula: apps with no dependency analyzer evidence
quality_kpis.decision_value: Blocks risky isolated migrations.
